tasks.description: Give resolveTool an opt-in workspace search with a name alias (playwright to @playwright/test), used only by launch(), per the Decision; update the header comment's D13 line and make the not-found message name the folders it searched. Serves O1, O2, O4. Dependencies: none. Acceptance criteria (8 items): every test neutralises the global lookup and asserts unique stub markers; workspace-stub found via pnpm-workspace.yaml (and absent without it -> ToolError); workspaces array / {packages} / flow-style YAML parsed and catalog: block ignored; !negation, ** entries and folders without package.json skipped; sorted-order choice between apps/a and apps/b; root @playwright/test found in single-package repo; no-opts call does NOT find workspace stub; not-found message names searched folders; existing exit-2 and design-bundle tests still pass. Full text is in the TRD Master Task List.

Rewrite /refine-design step 3's critique.md instruction as a per-board merge, per the Decision, and extend refine-design-prose.test.js. Serves O3. Dependencies: none. Acceptance criteria (4 items): refine-design.md no longer says 'overwritten each run' for critique.md and says to read the existing file first, keep unchanged boards' sections, and keep earlier scores labelled 'predate this run's change' for a changed board not re-judged; header line names command and date of the last run to touch the file; prose test asserts each and fails on old text; create-design.md whole-file write unchanged.

Make /refine-design's critique.md header rule its own step, so every run rewrites the file's first line with the command and date (a live refine on lightning-lane, 2026-11-06, merged per board but left the header '# Critique (before the fix round)'). Amendment, 2026-11-06. Serves: amendment (no objective ID). Dependencies: FIX-002. Acceptance criteria: (1) refine-design.md (and its .claude/ mirror) states the header rewrite as its own bullet, naming the line's form and that it is rewritten every run; (2) the prose test asserts that bullet and fails on the old single-sentence text. NOTE: this task has no Task Grounding block in the TRD, so its touches list is empty (not stated in the TRD); the TRD's Master Task List has an empty Acceptance Criteria cell for it, and its acceptance criteria above are taken from the same row's (1) and (2) text.
